reason: I only have Saturdays, so $49-59 a month for maybe three or four visits is hard to justify when daycare just got more expensive. A $12 drop-in is more my speed, but I would not commit to anything before seeing it.
objection: It's open to kids up to 5 and I have a baby. I don't see anything saying the little ones are kept apart from bigger kids running around, and I don't want mine knocked over.
would_change_my_mind: A separate, fenced baby/toddler area or set baby-only hours on Saturday mornings, plus a free or cheap first visit to try it.
